source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: At the close of the opposing [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), you may pay 1 **Pain token** for this unit to become [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain) if no enemy is within its **Engagement Range**. Paying takes it off the battlefield and puts it in [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves).

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
